edges.reason: The name_ parameter is written into the _name state variable by the constructor.
The symbol_ parameter is written into the _symbol state variable by the constructor.
The decimals_ parameter is forwarded to the ERC20Decimals constructor.
The initialBalance_ parameter is validated and passed as the mint amount.
The feeReceiver_ parameter is forwarded to the ServicePayer base constructor.
The constructor mints the entire initial supply to the caller-derived msg.sender address.
The constructor calls _mint to create the initial token supply.
_mint credits the untrusted caller address determined via _msgSender.
The user-supplied initial balance is added to total supply and balance state in _mint.
The derived constructor invokes the ServicePayer base constructor.
feeReceiver_ is passed as the receiver address into the ServicePayer constructor.
ServicePayer performs an external payable call to the caller-supplied receiver, granting execution control to an untrusted address.
The untrusted feeReceiver_ address is cast to IPayable and invoked in the external call.
The external pay call can execute arbitrary receiver code before the constructor finishes initializing state.
_mint increases the recipient entry in the _balances mapping.
_mint increases the _totalSupply state variable.
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
transfer uses _msgSender as the debit source of the transfer.
transferFrom delegates token movement to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom derives the spender identity from the untrusted msg.sender.
The cached currentAllowance value is compared and reduced by the transferred amount.
approve writes into the _allowances mapping for the caller and spender.
_transfer debits the sender balance and credits the recipient balance in _balances.
decimals returns the immutable _decimals state value.
